templates.title: Mood-aware companion
templates.description: Tracks a companion's emotional state across the conversation. A classifier detects affection, rudeness, and playfulness, updating mood and intensity variables that color the companion's tone.

templates.title: HP tracker
templates.description: Tracks hit points across the conversation. A classifier watches for damage and healing events, and a Stage Direction surfaces current HP and a status label every turn.

templates.title: Stamina tracker with regen
templates.description: Analogous to HP tracking, but models exertion and rest. Heavy activity drains stamina; resting regenerates it. A flag signals rest turns so the prose can ease.

templates.title: Scene-aware background swapper
templates.description: Detects location changes, identifies the destination, and generates a new background image. Two classifiers chain: one detects movement, one names the destination with the LLM.

templates.title: NPC relationship tracker
templates.description: Tracks affinity scores for three named NPCs. A target classifier identifies who the player is talking to; an affinity classifier raises or lowers the right score based on player behavior.

templates.title: Branching scenario
templates.description: Models a three-way story branch gated by act. A classifier detects the player's choice; Stage Direction rules fire the correct act transition and scene description.

templates.title: Four-slot inventory
templates.description: Maintains four named item slots. A classifier detects pickup and drop events and sets an inventory-full flag that locks further pickups until something is dropped.

templates.title: Mystery investigation
templates.description: Clue counter, per-suspect suspicion scores, and a case-solved flag. A single multi-label classifier handles discoveries, evidence attribution, and final accusations.

templates.title: Persistent memory log
templates.description: A fact-worthy classifier detects when a response establishes a lasting detail. A Text generator extracts a one-sentence summary, appending it to a running fact list injected every turn.

templates.title: Time-of-day proxy
templates.description: A turn counter advances automatically each input. A computed expression maps turn ranges to morning, afternoon, evening, and night, shaping lighting and NPC availability via Stage Direction.
